situation.summary: Edwin Vale (landlord) asked on 3 Sep 2025 for the current solar generation reading at 14 Brindlefern Walk. No fault, spend or contractor is involved. The agency has chased the tenant, Ivo Mercer, four times by email and once by SMS, and each follow-up window expired with no reply. On 18 Sep the tenant replied that the readings were already supplied about two weeks earlier, that his wife had phoned and emailed the office, and he gave no figures. The agency has no record of that supply, has never updated the landlord since his call, and has not yet asked the tenant to verify or resend the figure.
situation.task: Verify the tenant's claim that the solar readings were already sent, and get the current generation reading to the landlord.
situation.stageLabel: Information request (solar reading): tenant reply received but disputed and unverified; decision needed on next ask
situation.whoseMove: The agency (Maya Chen) is next. It needs to send the tenant one precise request for the current kWh figure or meter/inverter photo, plus the date and recipient of the earlier readings he says were sent. It also needs to check the office phone log and shared inbox for the wife's call and email. The tenant has not supplied any figure. The landlord has been waiting 15 days with no update from the agency.

decision.actionLabel: Ask the tenant to resend the solar generation reading (or forward the earlier email) and say when and where it was sent
decision.message:
Dear Ivo,

Thank you for your reply, and I'm sorry for the repeated messages. You say your wife phoned the office and emailed the readings about two weeks ago. I can't see them on this request, so they may have reached a different inbox or not been linked to it. We are checking our own phone and email records now.

So that we can get the reading to your landlord without more delay, could you please do one of the following by Monday 22 September:

1. Forward the email your wife sent, with the reading or photo still attached, to me at this address; or
2. Reply with the current kWh figure from the solar generation meter or inverter display, or a photo of the screen.

It would also help to know roughly what date the email was sent and which email address it went to, so that we can find the original.

Once we have the reading we will pass it to your landlord and won't need to contact you again about this request. If anything is unclear, just reply here.

Kind regards,
Maya Chen
Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings
decision.rationale: The latest real message (E017) is the tenant saying the readings were already supplied by his wife's phone call and email. He gave no figures. Our record shows no reading on this request, despite asks on 3, 9, 14 and 18 Sep (E006, E010, E013, E014, E016) and expiry notices saying no reply was visible (E009, E012, E015). The landlord's request (E001) cannot be answered without the figure. The tenant's claim has to be checked, not assumed, so the right step is a different ask from a plain chase: forward the original or resend, and say when and where it went. The landlord has had no update in 15 days (E001), so he hears the status in the same turn, with a date. No spend, contractor or safety issue is involved. The approval status (E003–E005) is workflow noise for an information request (E007).
decision.expectedOutcome: The tenant forwards his wife's original email or sends the current kWh figure or photo, ideally with the date and address it was first sent to. We can then pass the reading to the landlord.

Dear Edwin,

I'm following up on your call of 3 September asking for the current solar generation reading at 14 Brindlefern Walk. I'm sorry you haven't heard from us since then.

We asked the tenant for the kWh figure from the generation meter or inverter display, or a photo of the screen. The tenant has told us it was sent to our office earlier, but no reading is linked to your request. I will check our office phone log and inbox, and I have asked the tenant to resend it.

I'll send you the reading as soon as we have it, and either way I'll update you by Monday 22 September.

Kind regards,
Maya Chen
Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings
